_about: Extraction gold, written 2026-10-28 by Claude from the article text, the theses the production request showed that day and the theme theses open then (gold-standard.md). No model answer was read for these 20 articles. Model-authored, then re-read once as a senior hedge-fund analyst (Alex, 2026-10-28: the author decides) and FROZEN on 2026-10-28 at that pass; the hash is in gold-extraction.sha256. Any later change is a new file with a version number and a reason. bears_on_now: the ids the request actually showed; bears_on_with_themes: the ids under proposal A (open theme theses shown too). An empty bears_on means an analyst would note it but no question in the library takes it: scored as no_destination, never as kept_right.
